messages:
sara: Heads-up — EU midnight change window is scheduled for tomorrow 00:00 UTC. Quick readiness check: can owners confirm freeze pinning, rollback lanes, release notes link, and the handoff owner for watch? @devon @li @tom

deploy-bot: Scheduled change window created: EU-midnight-2026-03-20 00:00 UTC. Reminder will be posted at T-60 and T-15. Canary cohort: eu-frontend-1 (10%).

devon: I can take watch for the first 45m. Rollback lanes: automated canary pin + manual rollback playbook in the runbook (link below). Smoke tests: perf + health + tokenization check. Release notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-8320 :page_facing_up: 

li: Pinning: all services will be pinned to image tag `redwood/frontend:2026-03-19-rc3` for the window. I pushed the pin to `deploy-config` and added the exempt list for monitoring tweaks.

pri: Migration flags: migration `user_index_shard` has been turned off in staging and canary. DB migration already ran in canary with no errors. If we need hotfix, plan is to revert flag + rollback service.

Tom: Verified canary throughput at 10% for last 30m. No errors >5xx. One slow call to /embed, traced to a quantization fallback — I added a temporary routing rule to route heavy requests to vcpu fallback. If we see regen errors we'll flip the routing back.

ops-bot: Oncall paged: @oncall-eu will be notified 10m before window. Incident channel: #incidents -> pinned runbook 'eu-midnight-rollback' (ID 9021).

devon: Rollback commands (kept in runbook):
```
# rollback frontend to previous stable
kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend=redwood/frontend:2026-03-09-stable -n eu-prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend -n eu-prod
# revert feature flag
redwood-flags set user_index_shard --env=prod --off
```

sara: Thanks. Two asks before we close this thread: 1) someone add a one-line summary in release notes calling out the quantization routing tweak, 2) confirm QA smoke owner for 00:05 post-cut smoke.

li: I added the note to the release notes doc.

Tom: QA smoke owner: assigning to @pri for the 00:05 run (will watch logs for embedding errors and latency).

pri: Got it. I'll run the smoke and post results in the channel at T+5.

sara: Perfect. If no objections, I'll mark this window as cleared and start the quiet-board at T-30. :white_check_mark: 

devon: No objections from me. I'll keep the escalation checklist open and do the handoff to oncall at T+45.

sara: Closing check-in. Good luck all — ping here for rollback triggers or unexpected degradation. :rocket:
